2073850.desc: 立即加入在以全世界著名城市為背景的虛擬競技場，展開激烈戰鬥的競技秀《THE FINALS》！ 在這款第一人稱射擊遊戲中，可破壞且變化多端的戰場上與隊友並肩作戰，利用獨有的戰鬥風格登上巔峰吧！

1222670.name: The Sims™ 4
1222670.review_detail: 1,218 篇使用者評論中有 80% 給予此遊戲好評。
1222670.desc: 享受在虛擬世界裡創造及控制人們的無上權力。 感受恣意控制的力量與自由、愉快玩樂，遊戲人生！

5064170.name: Go Next!
5064170.review_detail: 26 篇使用者評論中有 92% 給予此遊戲好評。
5064170.desc: 武器自動開火，你只管不停移動。跑牆、衝刺、兔子跳，穿越 11 個世界的怪物大潮，用 71 種武器和 131 件物品打造勢不可擋的流派。可單人遊玩，也可最多 4 人線上合作。

1938090.name: 《決勝時刻®》
1938090.review_detail: 3,122 篇使用者評論中有 44% 給予此遊戲好評。
1938090.desc: 《決勝時刻®》體驗支援《現代戰爭® 4》、《黑色行動 7》、《黑色行動 6》和《決勝時刻®：現代戰域™》。

440.name: Team Fortress 2
440.review_detail: 6,390 篇使用者評論中有 89% 給予此遊戲好評。
440.desc: 九種各具特色的職業，提供能發揮廣泛的戰術技巧和能力的機會。 持續推出更新——新的遊戲模式、地圖、物品和最重要的帽子！

5460060.name: Debriefed : Frontline Command
5460060.desc: 指揮官，你的裝甲列車離戰爭結束還隔著十六名敵軍軍官。卡牌戰裡贏了她們，她們就編進小隊。官舍裡把威士忌倒下，無修正的動畫場景就開。買一次就夠。沒有微型交易。

5001770.name: Farmstead Market Simulator
5001770.desc: 建設並發展屬於你的農場和路邊商店。種植作物、飼養動物、製作高價值商品、訂定價格、僱用員工、補充貨架、接待顧客，將小小的生意逐步發展成興旺的事業。

3944590.name: Relocat
3944590.desc: A heartfelt New Year’s story about relocation and growing up. From wrapping gifts to navigating bureaucracy, can you adjust to a new life and discover what home means to you now?

5036510.name: Kreabordis
5036510.desc: Kreabordis is a puzzle game where you have to strategically place creatures on a board to score the most points. Defeat challengers, maximize your points in tricky puzzles and find the perfect move.

5063450.name: Industry Unbound：无界工业
5063450.desc: 一款以無限畫布為核心的自動化工廠策略遊戲。開採資源、規劃物流、平衡電力、保障聚居地供給並研究新科技，建設自給自足的星球工業體系。

3823530.name: Emberbound: Three Pyres
3823530.desc: Leave a trail of fire and close loops to burn the horde in this solo survival action game. Chain captures, combine ten powers and brave intense pyre trials before facing the guardians of three haunted realms.

4449800.name: TaskFall
4449800.desc: In TaskFall, you and your friends take on tasks from the mysterious Citadel. The work is not difficult. At least, that’s what they say in the Citadel. Complete tasks on fully destructible levels, make it out alive, buy new equipment, and gradually uncover the secrets of the Citadel.

3124570.name: Crosshair Overlay
3124570.desc: Design your own crosshair and see it in the centre of your screen in any game, drawn by Xbox Game Bar. Shape it with sliders or draw it pixel by pixel, animate it, and switch, hide or trigger animations with global hotkeys. Nothing is injected into the game.

5204140.name: a strange journey into the backrooms
5204140.desc: A strange journey into the backrooms is an atmospheric exploration game focused on an introspective psychological voyage rather than mere survival. Navigate a lethal, endless labyrinth filled with forgotten stories and liminal spaces that stretch beyond the limits of human imagination.
